messages:
Maya (Marketing): :wave: Quick sync — planning a partner spotlight blog series with CloudArc. Goal: 3 short posts + 1 demo highlight post. Launch window: 4/12 - 4/26. Need final assets + lead routing plan.
Alex (Sales): Love it. Who owns the demo follow-up? We should ensure leads from the CloudArc marketplace get prioritized to AE queue.
Nate (Product): We can provide a 10-min recorded connector demo and an animated GIF for the posts. Also can do an FAQ doc for the blog.
Sophia (Partner): CloudArc can promote on their marketplace homepage week of launch. They'll drive traffic, but we need UTM and lead mapping details.
Jas (GrowthOps): Proposed lead routing rules (can someone validate):
```
if source == "cloudarc_marketplace":
  assign -> "AE-cloudarc"
  priority -> "high"
  tags -> ["partner:cloudarc","campaign:partner-spotlight"]
  utm_source = "cloudarc"
```
Maya (Marketing): @Jas that looks good. Two asks: 1) confirm AE mailbox + Slack channel for hot leads, 2) ensure leads get the blog gating email template.
Alex (Sales): AE mailbox is sales+cloud@redwood.com. Hot leads should ping #sales-cloud so we can triage quickly.
Nate (Product): For gating — do we require demo-watch before form submission, or optional? My vote: optional but encourage with incentive (early access to connectors preview).
Sophia (Partner): CloudArc prefers minimal friction. So optional gating with a clear CTA to request a live walkthrough works for them.
Jas (GrowthOps): I'll set up routing in LeadRouter and add the tags. Template for auto-reply:
"Thanks for your interest in the Redwood x CloudArc connector. An AE will reach out within 48 hours. In the meantime, here is the 10-min demo: <link>"
Maya (Marketing): Nice — can someone drop the final UTM pattern? I want to add to the post templates.
Jas (GrowthOps): UTM pattern: `?utm_source=cloudarc&utm_medium=partner_listing&utm_campaign=partner_spotlight_apr26`
Alex (Sales): Also add `?utm_content=blog_demo_cta` for the demo CTA so we can filter.
Maya (Marketing): Wanna lock imagery by EOW. Nate can you share gif + demo link by Fri?
Nate (Product): Yep. I'll upload to Drive and paste links here by Friday morning.
LeadRouterBot: New test lead routed -> id: 79342, source: cloudarc_marketplace, assigned: Alex (Sales)
Alex (Sales): Got the test lead, pinged the AE team. The auto-reply looks clean. One more ask: include a field in the lead form for "Product use case" so AE can prep.
Maya (Marketing): Good call. I'll add that to the blog gating form and the marketplace listing instructions.
Sophia (Partner): CloudArc marketing will also do a small social push. Can we draft co-branded copy? Maya, I can take a stab and send to you.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect — send to me in DM or drop in this thread. Final checklist before launch: assets, UTM, routing, AE channel, demo link, co-brand copy. Marking on calendar.
Jas (GrowthOps): I'll create the LeadRouter rule and share a short runbook for AEs.
Alex (Sales): Thanks team. Excited to see how many leads we get from CloudArc.
Maya (Marketing): :rocket: Thanks all — will follow up with a calendar invite for launch day prep.
